title: Military video of instantaneous acceleration with a weapons-grade lock, obtained and released by Corbell and Knapp

tellings.quote: dive analysis that came out, right? Because George and I obtained and released it.

plain: The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says that he and the Las Vegas journalist George Knapp obtained and released a military video in which an object accelerates instantly while a weapons system has a firing lock on it. Corbell tells this to Michels as one of the people who put the footage out, pointing to an analysis that followed it, since an object moving that way under a weapons lock would be beyond any known aircraft.
